author: KEXP
description:
Helado Negro and Reyna Tropical form a harmonious union on their debut collaborative album 'Helado Tropical.' With host @albinacabrera, the duo share bewitching rhythms through a performance of "Tocando" and more. 

Support the sessions you love featuring artists you love during our Fall Drive! With a gift of $10/month or more, you ensure programming like this remains accessible to all.
title: Helado Tropical performs "Tocando" & more Live on KEXP
